name: campus-ministry-pwa
description: CS 144 final project: PWA for campus Christian ministry (chat + bible-study scheduling + calendar) deployed on GKE.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm -w frontend run dev" "npm -w backend run dev"
scripts.lint: npm -w frontend run lint && npm -w backend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm -w frontend run typecheck && npm -w backend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm -w frontend run test && npm -w backend run test
scripts.build: npm -w frontend run build && npm -w backend run build
scripts.rules:test: npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "npm -w backend run test:rules"
